blurb:
Create your own signature perfume in a warm and cozy boutique-style studio in South Lake Tahoe. This hands-on fragrance experience combines creativity, scent blending, and guided instruction as you explore a curated scent bar and craft a perfume that is uniquely yours.

Designed to feel elevated yet approachable, this intimate workshop offers a relaxing atmosphere perfect for date nights, girls’ trips, solo travelers, and creative experiences with family or friends. Leave with a custom-blended perfume in a luxury-style glass bottle and a memorable experience inspired by the atmosphere of Lake Tahoe.
